title: Typed Query IR V1 contract and conformance closure

approval_gates.purpose: Approve this exact plan and scope; no code dispatch.
Separately authorize implementation after G0; until then all worker tasks remain disabled.

architecture_decision.wave: W1 is contract/conformance closure over existing implementations, not an executor rewrite.
architecture_decision.unverified_boundary: Source presence is not a fresh end-to-end conformance PASS; capability declarations and behavior must be verified.
preserve: current public contracts unless a separately reviewed finding proves a mismatch

architecture_analysis.status: analysis supplied; subject to owner review

verify_gate.rule: Run the listed commands on one candidate SHA; preserve exact outputs, exit codes, and skips.

final_gate.rule: Fail closed unless Verify PASS, Review PASS, docs aligned, and acceptance criteria are evidenced.

parallelism.rule: Unordered tasks must have disjoint write_set values. Read-only audit/gates may overlap writers only when they inspect an immutable baseline and rerun after candidate changes.
serialized_shared_file_tasks: C0 before C1; merge C0+C1 atomically
H1 and R1 before N1 when N1 needs conditional src/lib.rs edits
parallelism.failure_rule: A correction creates a new candidate revision and invalidates every dependent Verify/Review/Final result; do not merge RED-only or stale evidence.

merge_stages.rule: Owner accepts the exact plan; this does not authorize code.
Separate explicit owner authorization is required before any W1 worker starts.
Schema and validator dependency are reviewed before fixture consumers.
Shared fixtures land only after the schema test exists.
One green core candidate; never merge intentional RED tests alone.
H1 and R1 may work in parallel with disjoint writes; X1 is evidence-only; merge code changes H1 then R1. X1 must complete before D1/V.
After H1/R1; conditionally owns any N-API binding correction after C1.
Reconcile docs after implementation evidence and before final validation/review.
Integrated deterministic Verify on one candidate SHA, including all focused and full gates.
Independent read-only Astra Review of the verified final candidate.
Final Gate; external merge/release/deployment requires its own authority.

acceptance_criteria: A standalone closed Draft 2020-12 schema and shared fixtures define supported V1 envelopes without widening approved semantics.
Existing supported operation behavior is tested against the accepted schema and truthful capability declarations across core, HQL, REST, and N-API.
Unsupported capabilities, including relational_named_query, reject explicitly with stable typed errors and without semantic degradation.
Bounds, defaults, capability reporting, and error mappings in the shared fixtures are sourced from explicit contract decisions rather than inferred implementation values.
Existing HQL fallback behavior remains unchanged unless an accepted test proves a contract mismatch.
Focused and full required tests pass on the same candidate SHA; skipped work is reported as unverified.
Independent Astra Review and final provenance/scope gate pass; canonical docs identify exact evidence and remaining NOT_RUN items.
W1 claims conformance only for verified surfaces; the overall accepted spec remains partial while broader SDK/MCP/NL-adapter gates remain incomplete.

tasks.title: Reconcile architecture docs and publish proposed W1 queue/graph
tasks.worker: Codex coordinator; architecture input from gpt-6-astra Max
tasks.exit: Parent/peer documents agree, the prior G3 baseline is reconciled, and the replacement queue/graph are explicitly non-dispatchable.

tasks.title: Owner approval of W1 plan and architecture boundary
verify: Explicit approval of the exact proposed queue/graph and non-goals
tasks.exit: Plan approval recorded; this gate alone does not authorize code dispatch.

tasks.title: Separate owner authorization to dispatch W1 implementation
tasks.exit: Worker tasks may start only after this separate authorization.

tasks.title: Freeze standalone Query IR V1 schema and schema-validation gate
tasks.notes: Use JSON Schema draft 2020-12. AJV is currently present transitively in package-lock; promote it to a direct test-only dependency and pin through the lockfile. No Rust dependency is needed for schema parsing; existing native typed validation remains separately tested.
tasks.exit: Closed schema validates valid/invalid envelopes and rejects unknown fields; dependency diff is test-only.

tasks.title: Add shared V1 request/response conformance fixture matrix
tasks.notes: Cross-check field closure, operation bounds, capability defaults, and unsupported selectors against the accepted spec and current runtime. Do not invent limits or defaults; if the spec/source conflict, stop for owner review before freezing the schema.
tasks.exit: Fixtures cover each supported operation and explicit unsupported/rejection cases; all fixtures validate against the frozen schema.

tasks.title: Characterize core executor and budget behavior with contract tests
tasks.notes: Characterize observed max_k/max_depth, budgets, capability output, and core typed-error behavior without changing production code. Treat observed values as non-normative until reconciled with the accepted contract.
tasks.merge_barrier: C0 and C1 form one candidate. Never merge a deliberately RED-only test stage.
tasks.exit: Acceptance tests expose any contract gap without changing production behavior.

tasks.title: Apply minimal core corrections only for verified C0 failures
tasks.exit: Core contract tests pass; every behavior change has an evidence-backed RCA and remains within accepted V1.

tasks.title: Verify and close HQL compatibility mapping without grammar expansion
verify: cargo test --locked --no-default-features --test hql_p0_tests --test hql_collection_tests --test hql_cypher_tests --test wave_e_context_tests
tasks.exit: Existing HQL supported paths preserve semantics; legacy fallback behavior remains intact.

tasks.title: Verify REST request/result/error-envelope conformance
tasks.notes: Characterize core-to-REST mappings (including beyond_horizon) in shared fixtures first; freeze only contract-required mappings and do not guess transport status/error semantics.
tasks.exit: REST matches the accepted schema, capability declarations, typed failures, and core results.

tasks.title: Verify N-API and TypeScript conformance after HQL/REST baselines

conditional_write_set.when: Only if N-API binding behavior is proven missing; after C1, H1, and R1, with affected gates rerun.

tasks.notes: Preserve the candidate's committed index.d.ts/index.js before the addon build, run the build in an isolated copy, compare preserved/generated directories with the existing freshness checker, and inspect any generated changes before integrating them.
tasks.exit: N-API results/errors match REST and TypeScript declarations accurately describe discriminated operation/result envelopes; generated artifacts are freshness-checked.

tasks.title: Audit declared SDK and MCP consumer support (evidence-only)
tasks.exit: Record supported, partial, unsupported, and NOT_RUN per consumer; do not add adapter scope or modify SDK/MCP files in this task.

tasks.title: Integrated Verify Gate on one immutable candidate SHA
tasks.verifier: Codex coordinator; deterministic commands and captured exit codes
tasks.exit: All required gates pass on the same candidate SHA; every skip/failure is explained and cannot be promoted to PASS.

tasks.title: Independent architecture and diff Review Gate
verify: Review changed files, acceptance mapping, task write sets, and exact Verify evidence
tasks.exit: Astra returns PASS or explicit findings; any changed candidate invalidates affected Verify and Review evidence.

tasks.title: Reconcile final implementation and evidence into canonical docs
tasks.worker: Codex coordinator; Luna may draft bounded docs after approval
tasks.exit: Status claims cite exact source SHA and evidence; unsupported and unrun surfaces remain explicit, and the overall spec stays partial until every accepted gate is satisfied.

tasks.title: Final Gate: acceptance, provenance, scope, and merge readiness
verify: Recheck acceptance criteria, immutable candidate SHA, Verify PASS, Astra Review PASS, docs consistency, and merge-order compliance
tasks.exit: PASS only when all required evidence is present; does not itself grant additional code scope, push, merge, release, or deployment authority.

verification_commands.focused_hql: cargo test --locked --no-default-features --test hql_p0_tests --test hql_collection_tests --test hql_cypher_tests --test wave_e_context_tests

evidence_limits: No power-loss/device/release/deployment/production claim follows from local tests.
A source implementation or passing focused test does not establish every V1 capability.
No SDK/MCP support is assumed without consumer-specific evidence.
